# Sharea color mapping — brand → Material 3 roles

Scheme: `material-color-utilities` (as used by shadcn M3E), variant `image`
(explicit key colors), spec 2021, contrast standard.

- **Seed / primary:** navy `#0F2A4A` (HCT hue 259.1, chroma 28)
- **Tertiary:** gold `#D4A24C` (HCT hue 78.9, chroma 39)
- **Neutrals:** navy hue, chroma 6 (neutral) / 10 (neutral-variant) → blue-gray
  outlines and deep navy surfaces (never pure black)

## Brand colors → M3 roles (dark scheme, the default experience)

| Brand token | Brand hex | M3 role(s) | Palette | Nearest tone | Generated hex (dark) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Royal / midnight navy | `#0F2A4A` | seed → primary palette; drives primary / secondary / neutrals | primary | 17 | (palette source) |
| Secondary navy | `#16375F` | covered by the primary palette (upper tones) | primary | 22 | #224876 |
| Deep background navy | `#0A1C33` | surface (dark) — navy-hued neutral, tone 6 | neutral (chroma 16) | 12 | #091423 |
| Main gold | `#D4A24C` | seed of the tertiary palette (its tone 70 ≈ brand gold) | tertiary | 70 | #d5a34d |
| Light gold (signature) | `#F3D48A` | tertiary (dark) — pinned to gold palette tone 86 | tertiary | 86 | #ffd189 |
| Deep gold | `#A87824` | on-tertiary (dark) — gold palette low tone | tertiary | 50 | #432c00 |
| Warm off-white | `#F5EEDC` | on-surface (dark) — pinned to the brand token | neutral | 100 | #F5EEDC |

> Two roles are pinned to exact brand tones (see the table): the dark-scheme
> **tertiary** (gold palette tone 86 — the signature soft gold, used for the
> CTA) and **on-surface** (the warm off-white). Everything else is generated
> from the seeds. The authoritative values are the roles in
> `src/lib/m3e/theme-sharea.css`. Highlights: surface =
> `#091423`; tertiary = `#ffd189`;
> on-tertiary = `#432c00`.
